title: Homocysteine
what: This is a blood test from a vein. Homocysteine is a substance whose level is linked to B vitamins and blood vessel health.
why: For blood vessel disease and blood clots, when planning a pregnancy, or for low vitamin B12 and folate.
duration: the blood draw takes 3 to 5 minutes; results usually come in 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: If you take vitamins, especially B vitamins and folic acid
If you take epilepsy medicines or medicines that lower immunity
If you have kidney or thyroid disease

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually strictly fasting, 8 to 12 hours without food. Water is fine.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: No alcohol, no fatty food or meat, and no hard workouts. Do not smoke in the morning.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Ask your doctor if you should pause vitamins before the test.

steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow, and the skin is wiped
Blood is drawn into a tube
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Results usually come in 1 to 3 days
Your doctor will explain the results

faq.q: What if my homocysteine is high?
faq.a: Often the cause is low B vitamins. Your doctor decides what to take and at what dose.

faq.q: Why test homocysteine when planning a pregnancy?
faq.a: It helps show if you have enough folate. Your doctor decides about vitamins.

reminders.text: Homocysteine test tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner. Water is fine.
